tasks.label: N.E.K.O: check openrails_copilot
tasks.command: uv run python -m plugin.neko_plugin_cli.cli check openrails_copilot

tasks.label: N.E.K.O: sync openrails_copilot
tasks.command: uv run --with pip python -m plugin.neko_plugin_cli.cli sync openrails_copilot --clean

tasks.label: N.E.K.O: check -r openrails_copilot
tasks.command: uv run python -m plugin.neko_plugin_cli.cli check -r openrails_copilot

tasks.label: N.E.K.O: build openrails_copilot
tasks.command: uv run python -m plugin.neko_plugin_cli.cli build openrails_copilot
